This study is a single-case (n=1 patient) with a within-participant before>after contrast comparing responses to images of boys vs girls; it uses visual sexual stimuli (children in swimsuits) and reports whole-brain model fit with reported peak coordinates. However, full-text inclusion criteria require at least one analysis involving within-participant cue>control contrasts (I4) — while the contrast is an interaction 'boys before > girls after' in a single patient, the study includes only n=1 patient and a control assessed separately; the record indicates a within-group interaction but the sample size (n=1) implies no group-level voxelwise statistical inference generalizable to a group. Neuroimaging meta-analysis requires group-level results; the record shows model fit over whole brain and reported peaks, but because participants n=1 for the patient condition, this fails group-level requirement (I5/GLOBAL_I1) and likely falls under exclusion E3 (only ROI or single-subject). The record also has design metadata missing or unclear for some criteria (e.g., small-volume correction not specified). Inclusion criteria met: I3 (visual cues). Inclusion not met: I4 (within-participant cue>control at group level) and I5 (group-level voxelwise result). Exclusion applied: E3.
